description.en: The ID of the cloud account.

description.zh:
多云的code。取值：
- qcloud：腾讯云。
- aliyun：阿里云。
- hcloud：华为云。
description.en:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

*   qcloud: Tencent Cloud
*   aliyun: Alibaba Cloud
*   hcloud: Huawei Cloud

description.zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。可调用[ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|ListDataSourceLogs)获取数据源ID。
description.en: The ID of the data source. The ID is an MD5 hash value that is calculated by the threat analysis feature based on specific parameters. You can call the [ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListDataSourceLogs) operation to query the IDs of data sources.

description.zh: 日志ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。可调用[ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|ListDataSourceLogs)获取日志ID。
description.en: The ID of the log. The ID is an MD5 hash value that is calculated by the threat analysis feature based on specific parameters. You can call the [ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListDataSourceLogs) operation to query the IDs of logs.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the regions in which your assets reside. Valid values:

*   cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in regions in China.
*   ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside in regions outside China.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem delete-data-source-log --log-instance-id ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --data-source-instance-id 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea --account-id 123xxxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem DeleteDataSourceLog --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --LogInstanceId ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DataSourceInstanceId 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea
